title: Samaṇā (2)
text: 1-2 Sāvatthi || || 3 Pañcime bhikkhave upādānakkhandhā || || Katame pañca || Seyyathīdam {rūpūpādānakkhandho} || pe || 4-5 Ye hi keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā imesam pañcannam upādānakkhandhānam samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ na pajānanti || pe || pajānanti || sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantīti || ||
